full_name: Mati Diop | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Filmmaker (France)
bio: Mati Diop is a filmmaker working in both France and Senegal. Her formally adventurous films explore exile and identity, memory and loss using fiction and documentary tools. Her most recent film, Mille soleils (A Thousand Suns) (2013), explores the intimate and collective heritage of her uncle Djibril Diop Mambéty’s iconic film Touki Bouki (1973).
